MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 40.5
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 10

2. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

4. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

5. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

6. Solve for x: x + 6 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 11
   C. 6
   D. 5

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 25
   C. 27
   D. 17

8. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 49
   D. 14

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 90

10. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

11. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 64
   D. 65

12. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 33
   C. 27
   D. 27.7

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 22
   C. 18
   D. 77

14. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 144

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 30
   C. 44
   D. 105

16. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 17
   C. 1
   D. 72

17. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 121

18. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

19. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/4

20. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

21. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

22. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 13

23. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

24. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
